You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I got stuck in an infinite loop of swapping items between the pantry and kitchen without ever actually brewing the potion. I collected the necessary ingredients (water, red beetle, spiderweb, sandwich) and tools (ice wand, fairy wand) but never executed the recipe steps in the kitchen. Specifically, I never poured the water, added the beetle, or used the wands on the cauldron. Next time, once I have the required items in my inventory (or can access them), I will immediately go to the kitchen and execute the recipe steps in order: 1) Pour water into the cauldron, 2) Add the red beetle, 3) Wiggle the fairy wand, 4) Wiggle the ice wand, 5) Add the spiderweb, and 6) Add the sandwich. I will manage my inventory by dropping items only when necessary to pick up the next ingredient, but I will prioritize performing the "add" and "wiggle" actions on the cauldron as soon as the corresponding item is in hand, rather than hoarding items or shuttling back and forth unnecessarily.

Trial #2: New plan: I failed because I did not complete the final step of the recipe (adding the spiderweb) and likely got stuck in a loop of traveling between rooms instead of finishing the task. My previous attempt successfully gathered the red beetle and spiderweb in the cellar, but I failed to execute the final "put spiderweb into cauldron" command before the attempt ended. Next time, once I have the red beetle and spiderweb in my inventory, I will immediately travel to the kitchen (via the hallway and magic workshop if necessary, or directly if the path is clear) and execute the remaining recipe steps in strict order: 1) Put the red beetle into the cauldron, 2) Put the spiderweb into the cauldron. Since the water, wands, and sandwich were already added in the previous attempt, I must ensure I do not get distracted by other rooms or items. If the game state resets, I will prioritize collecting the red beetle and spiderweb from the cellar first, then immediately proceed to the kitchen to finish the brewing sequence without unnecessary detours.
